description: Minimal IPC surface for floating browser windows loading remote pages. Only the injected Flobro toolbar uses this: window dragging plus the app's own float_* commands. The port needs a wildcard of its own: Tauri matches the page's whole URL against these patterns, and a pattern that omits the port matches only the scheme's default port, so 'https://**' silently excluded every dev server on localhost:5173 and every site on a custom port (#18). The schemes stay explicit because '*://*:*' would open this surface to any scheme at all.
